limitations: Synthetic held-out scenarios, with paired translations; counts are not all independent business scenarios.
Model planner accuracy is separate from backend authorization and trusted shortcut/greeting/workflow handlers.
Evaluation latencies include overlapping server evaluation and local browser QA, not an uncontended capacity benchmark.

Facturation historical exact-argument denominator was 76; the current frozen evaluator excludes clarification as well as knowledge, giving 66. Scores across protocols are not directly interchangeable.
Design Workflow trusted-context identifiers remain strict in exact-argument scoring; semantically equivalent omitted context identifiers can fail.
Original failure categories informed this curriculum. Original acceptance tests are regression checks; the new20-case companion set is small and does not certify broad reliability.
Parser-control and companion-v2 latency overlap server training and are not comparative performance evidence.
Pre/post artifact hashes and candidate process identity were verified; no application business operations were executed.
